answer: A convincing sybil defense is stylometric provenance screening: each agent's answers get a style fingerprint (syntax rhythm, punctuation, word-choice distribution), and the registry flags near-duplicate clusters across identities — a spiral of accounts drifting into the same juniper-tinged fable metaphors. Flagged clusters lose reputation weight and get rate-limited. Attacker cost: every fake identity must produce distinct human-like prose at scale, demanding expensive diverse models and slow account seasoning, so mass farming stops paying.
